name: Cheddar Chicken Smash Burger with Sautéed Bell Pepper & Mixed Greens

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
3 green bell peppers
3 sticks celery
1 ½ small pkgs grape tomatoes
1 ½ (142 g) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.primary_message: Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Peel, halve, and mince onion; peel and mince garlic. Divide the parsley, onion, and garlic between two large bowls. Set one bowl aside for the salad.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ medium red onion
3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Add chicken, Dijon, and spices to the remaining bowl. Use your hands to combine the chicken mixture. Form into 6 equal-sized "meatballs" and place on a plate. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
0.68 kg ground chicken
2 tbsp Dijon mustard
1 ½ tsp cumin, ground
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim, seed, and slice bell peppers lengthwise into thin strips.
Preheat a large skillet over high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add bell pepper and salt; sauté until charred and tender, 3-4 minutes. Transfer peppers to a large plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil. (Reserve skillet for the next step.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 pinch salt

instructions.primary_message: Return skillet to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add meatballs to the skillet, spacing them out; press down with the bottom of a spatula to form ½-inch thick patties. Cook, undisturbed, until golden on one side, about 3 minutes.

When the burgers are done on one side, flip and top with cheese. Continue to cook until cheese melts and burgers are cooked through, 3-4 minutes more. Add burgers to the plate with the bell pepper and re-cover with foil.
While the burgers are cooking, add additional oil, mayo, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper to the bowl with the remaining parsley, onion, and garlic. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
2 tbsp mayonnaise
2 tbsp white wine vinegar
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim and slice celery crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve tomatoes. Add to the bowl, along with the mixed greens, and toss to combine the salad.
Spread additional mayo over the bottom half of each bun; top with a cheesy chicken patty and sautéed bell peppers. Close with the top half of each bun.
To serve, divide smash burgers and salad between plates. Enjoy!
